summary: EDA controller scales horizontally with any number of nodes: `api` nodes serve the REST API, `worker` nodes manage projects and run activations, and `hybrid` nodes do both. Set them in `[automationedacontroller]` with `eda_node_type` and `routable_hostname`.
questions: How do I scale Event-Driven Ansible horizontally?
What are EDA api and worker node types?

answer_card.title: EDA node types (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationedacontroller]
3.88.116.111 routable_hostname=automationedacontroller-api.example.com eda_node_type=api
3.88.116.112 routable_hostname=automationedacontroller-api.example.com eda_node_type=worker
```
`api` = REST API, `worker` = projects and activations, `hybrid` = both.
